data.name: Mage Escape 2000
data.detailed_description:
Enter the Isle. Escape with your soul.

Mage Escape 2000 is a top-down, co-op extraction action RPG where up to sixteen banished mages dive into the shattered afterlife — part Diablo-style dungeon crawler, part high-stakes extraction run, all intense PvPvE chaos.

Every raid drops you onto the Cursed Isle, a collapsing realm filled with monsters, traps, and rival players hunting for the same relics you are.
Raids last about 15 minutes — but one bad decision sends everything you carried straight to the dirt.

Die, and lose it all.
Extract, and your spoils live forever.

⚔ Raid. Loot. Escape.

Go solo or gather a squad.
Fight through burning forests, ruined temples, shadowed caves, and catacombs crawling with spirits.

Loot powerful spell scrolls, enchanted artifacts, and cursed gear that twists the rules of death itself.

Dive deeper for legendary rewards — or escape early before the Isle devours you.

🪄 Forge Your Legacy

Between raids, return to your Town Hub — your refuge between runs:

  • Upgradeable stash for long-term hoarding and planning

  • Vendors with rotating goods and rare finds

  • A growing library of spells, consumables, and builds to experiment with

  • Quests & trinkets to chase while you raid

Everything you extract fuels your progression.
Everything you lose… is gone.

✨ A Glimpse Into the Isle

Early playable abilities include:

🌪 Cyclone Scroll

Pull enemies into a spinning vortex and yeet them across the map.

❄️ Freeze

Lock threats in ice — perfect for escapes or ambushes.

⚡ Lightning

Arc electricity between enemies with explosive force.

🔥 Placeable Campfire

Heal your squad mid-raid… if you can defend the flame.

💀 Risk Everything

The Isle rewards greed — and punishes it tenfold.
Go deeper. Get richer.
Or die and leave nothing but bones.

🌐 Multiplayer & Systems

  • 32-player co-op lobbies (local hosting or dedicated servers)

  • Fully server-authoritative combat

  • Proximity voice & text chat

  • Hundreds of spells & consumables

  • Knockback physics, cancelable skills, stealth & crouching

  • Sound-rich inventory, corpse looting, and extraction events

The Isle remembers every soul that enters.
Will it remember yours?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD 630 / NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 / AMD R7 260 (DX11 / Vulkan compatible)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
  • Additional Notes: Requires a keyboard and mouse. Controller supported as well.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 3060 / AMD RX 580 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
  • Additional Notes: Runs best on dedicated GPUs. Stable 60 FPS expected at 1080p.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11 (Big Sur)
  • Processor: Apple M1 / Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 GPU / Intel Iris Plus or equivalent with Metal support
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any compatible sound device
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit CPU and Metal-compatible GPU.
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 12 (Monterey) or newer
  • Processor: Apple M1 / M2 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 GPU / AMD Radeon with 4 GB VRAM or better
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any compatible sound device
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended. Gamepad and Steam Input supported.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: SteamOS 3.0 / Ubuntu 20.04 (64-bit) or equivalent
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Vulkan-compatible GPU (e.g. Intel Iris, NVIDIA GTX 750, AMD R7 260)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: ALSA / PulseAudio compatible
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit OS. Playable on Steam Deck using Vulkan.
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: SteamOS 3.0 / Ubuntu 22.04 (64-bit) or equivalent
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580 or better (Vulkan-compatible)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: ALSA / PulseAudio compatible
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended. Gamepad and Steam Input fully supported.
